notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote, MVA1 (OMIM:257300, AR). Allele 1 NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.(Leu737Ter) - nonsense in exon 17/23, ClinVar VCV000533901 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic for MVA1 (multiple submitters, no conflicts), gnomAD v4 AF~1e-4. Allele 2 c.3006T>G p.(Asn1002Lys) - missense in kinase domain exon 23/23, gnomAD v4 exomes 1 allele (~9e-7), AlphaMissense 0.923, MVP 0.852 (REVEL 0.472, discordant - see report). Matches the canonical MVA1 architecture of one null plus one hypomorphic allele (Hanks 2004; Suijkerbuijk 2010, where kinase-domain missense act via protein destabilisation, BUBR1 being a pseudokinase). AlphaFold AF-O60566 places Asn1002 at pLDDT 91.1 buried in an aromatic/hydrophobic cluster (V998 3.4A, F977, W978); Asn->Lys is a destabilising substitution. Recovered rank 1 genome-wide by an unbiased Exomiser 15.1.0 run (data 2512) from 4.93M variants using only the supplied HPO terms. Phase not directly demonstrable: the two variants are 10.9 kb apart, beyond Illumina fragment length, and no parental samples are available; trans configuration is inferred from recessive disease architecture.
